stories.title: Flintshire and Wrexham the most productive places in Wales, ONS figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire and Wrexham are the most productive places in Wales, according to new figures from the Office for National Statistics (ONS). stories.title: Flintshire councillors to discuss joint archive funding increase behind closed doors
stories.summary: Flintshire councillors will discuss in private on Monday a proposal to put more money into the joint archive project the county shares with Denbighshire. stories.title: 64 Flintshire patients still in hospital days after they were ready to go home
stories.summary: On one day in October, 64 Flintshire people were still in hospital at least two days after they were ready to go home. stories.title: Flintshire’s education chief says council must put more money into schools as deficit hits £3.5m
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s education chief has told councillors the council must put more money into schools, after their combined balances fell £3.5 million into the red. stories.summary: The health board that runs NHS services in Flintshire and across North Wales does not have what it needs to deliver and sustain improvement, an independent review has concluded.
